verdict_detail: Router-side, not provider. NO token over-consumption: the code consumes exactly 1 Electron Hub token per dispatched candidate entry and under-counts inner requests. Skips come from the live Electron Hub rate_limit_per_minute = 2 (not 8; was 8 on Oct 6) against ~2-4 sequential requests/min, plus the skip-instead-of-wait policy and an Errors tab that renders attempt rows with a blank reason.
under_count_sites: crates/ai-gateway/src/router/router.rs:52-82 - SearchResubmitter (Codex Search rounds) calls attempt_with_retry; real EH request, no token
crates/ai-gateway/src/router/router.rs:4737 - same-provider retry loop; no token per retry
router_defects: crates/ai-gateway/src/router/router.rs:6303-6321 - skips to a minutes-slower fallback when a token is <=30s away (no bounded wait); message 'Rate limit exhausted' does not say the request was never sent
crates/ai-gateway/src/dashboard/mod.rs:586-599 - recent_errors filters status>=400 only within newest limit*4 rows
crates/ai-gateway/src/dashboard/static/index.html:804-817 - renderErrors shows e.error||e.response_body, both null on content-free attempt rows; error_class and attempt/final kind not shown
user_decision_needed: Confirm whether Electron Hub rate_limit_per_minute should be 2 (current live) or 8 (Oct 6 value).
